company.shortDescription: Discord is an online voice, video, and text communication platform designed for creating communities.
company.description: Discord operates as a voice, video, and text communication service to talk and hang out with friends and communities. It was originally created for people who loved to play games, but these passionate people realized it could be enjoyed for more purposes. Discord is now used by everyone from local hiking clubs, to art communities, to study groups.

aiResearchSummary.text: Discord is focused on enhancing user interaction and content management on its platform. Research includes detecting shifts in language use, potentially to maintain the integrity of communication within communities. Another area involves expanding semantic classes, leveraging user feedback to refine content labeling and improve content relevance. Additionally, a machine-learning notification service is being developed to optimize notification delivery, ensuring users receive pertinent information without unnecessary interruption. These developments aim to improve user experience, content moderation, and engagement on the platform.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,500,000,000 to $3,527,982,379, a 1.01x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 79 (-16 over 90 days) and market heat at 73 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
